About

I am a software developer and M.Sc. student focused on cloud computing and DevOps. I like systems where a change moves from a commit to a live site without manual steps, and where a bad release can be undone quickly.

How this site is delivered

Source

Every change goes through a pull request, automated checks and review before it reaches the main branch.

Hosting

Files sit in a private S3 bucket. CloudFront serves them over HTTPS from edge locations.

Recovery

S3 versioning keeps earlier files, and a manual workflow redeploys any earlier Git version.

© 2026 Nikhil. Hosted on AWS S3 and CloudFront, deployed by GitHub Actions.
